notes: Badland Brawl je fyzikální 1v1/2v2 prakový tower-brawler od Frogmind (později HypeHype); karty se nazývaji 'Clones'. Hra nemá opoziční frakce jako Clash Royale — nejbližší ekvivalent jsou 'Lands' (progresní tematické sety: Jungle, Canyon, Frozen, Inferno), použité zde jako pole 'faction'. Statistiky jsou level-1 (základní) hodnoty z wiki tabulek; hra byla vývojářem v posledních letech utlumena/opuštěna.

factions.name: Jungle
factions.description: První tematický set Lands (Dawn/Noon/Dusk/Night) pro raný postup a odemykání karet; nejde o soupeřící frakci, ale o vizuální/odemykací tier.

factions.name: Canyon
factions.description: Druhý tematický set Lands, odemyká se kolem 800+ trofejí; pouštní/kaňonové téma.

factions.name: Frozen
factions.description: Třetí tematický set Lands, odemyká se kolem 2000+ trofejí; ledové/sněžné téma.

factions.name: Inferno
factions.description: Čtvrtý tematický set Lands, odemyká se kolem 3200+ trofejí; sopečné/ohnivé téma, následuje Season Portal (žebříček).

cards.name: Doggos
abilities: Splits into three small Doggo units on impact
Cheap, used to finish off weakened enemies or clones
cards.description: Affordable units that assist other clones in finishing opponents.

cards.name: Mini Bomb
abilities: Area damage explosion on impact
Cheap 1-mana cycle card
cards.description: A rolling bomb designed for direct physical contact with enemies.

cards.name: Plain Bomb
abilities: Area damage explosion on impact
Can be pushed by other clones for extra reach
cards.description: An explosive that becomes dangerous when pushed by other forces.

cards.name: Arrows
abilities: Fires 15 arrows in a spread across the bridge
Can carry/push airborne clones toward the enemy tower
Usable offensively or defensively
cards.description: Projectiles that slow or impede moving units.

cards.name: Balloon
abilities: Lifts friendly or enemy clones into the air
Can create passage under it for other units
Can be used to block or disrupt enemy combos
cards.description: An airborne unit that bypasses ground congestion.

cards.name: Blast Rocket
abilities: Propels everything in front of it toward the opponent's tower
Can push units past obstacles/blockers
cards.description: A propulsion tool that accelerates other clones forward.

cards.name: Bomb Birds
abilities: 4 slow-moving flying units per cast
Explodes on death, dealing area damage
cards.description: Flying explosives that pursue and detonate on targets.

cards.name: Fireball
abilities: Area explosion damage for bridge/wave control
cards.description: An area-clearing projectile for bridge control.

cards.name: Icicle
abilities: Slows/freezes enemy clones it hits
Synergizes with Core Lightning for double damage
cards.description: A ranged freeze projectile for slowing threats.

cards.name: Rogue
abilities: Rolls forward and can throw enemy bombs back at their tower
Can carry a friendly bomb forward
Deals bonus charge/sling-hit damage (317 at level 1)
cards.description: A small agile unit dealing increased damage when properly launched.

cards.name: Spiky
abilities: Loses hitpoints with each bounce
Deals high damage to clones on contact (556 at level 1)
cards.description: A bouncing unit whose spikes damage enemies on impact.

cards.name: Big Smith
abilities: Hammer stomp attack dealing extra damage (440 at level 1) when launched onto enemy units
Pushes enemies backward on hit
cards.description: A hammer-wielding clone that pushes enemies backward.

cards.name: Blast Bot
abilities: Explodes when destroyed, pushing nearby units outward
Can be used to propel bombs toward the tower
cards.description: A unit that propels bombs toward objectives.

cards.name: Blast Mine
abilities: Detonates on contact with enemy units, or after a delay
Explosion pushes nearby units
cards.description: An explosive that sticks to units and adds pushing force.

cards.name: Magnet
abilities: Pulls/attracts all other clones (friendly and enemy) toward itself
Useful both defensively and for grouping combos
cards.description: A collector that gathers and carries multiple strong clones.

cards.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities: Sticks to the first unit (friendly or enemy) it touches
Detonates after roughly 5 seconds dealing area damage
cards.description: A projectile bomb that adheres to targets.

cards.name: Spinning Saw
abilities: Fast rolling movement
Can carry other units forward with it
cards.description: A rotating blade unit that damages approaching enemies.

cards.name: Wildfire
abilities: Creates a burning zone on the bridge (10s lifetime)
Damage accumulates the longer enemies stand in it
cards.description: A fire-based unit amplified by slowing effects.

cards.name: Bomb Fly
abilities: Flying unit that drops a bomb when destroyed
Dropped bomb can be pushed toward the enemy tower
cards.description: A small flying bomb that distracts enemy defenses.

cards.name: Bouncy Bomb
abilities: Bounces multiple times before settling/detonating
Harder to control than Plain Bomb but deals more damage
cards.description: A hopping explosive that detonates after several bounces.

cards.name: Flying Doggos
abilities: 5 flying units per cast
Intercepts/attacks airborne carriers like Balloon or Snatcher
cards.description: Airborne support units defending against aerial threats.

cards.name: Floating Bomb
abilities: Hovers/floats toward the target before exploding
Area damage on impact
cards.description: A hovering explosive dealing substantial tower damage.

cards.name: Doggo House
abilities: Continuously spawns Doggos (roughly every 1.4s)
Stationary structure; can be pushed forward by its own Doggos to chip tower damage
cards.description: A flying structure spawning aggressive canine units.

cards.name: Fire Birds
abilities: 4 flying units per cast
Can slow or push back incoming units for tower defense
cards.description: Multiple fire projectiles overwhelming strong opponents.

cards.name: Replicant Saw
abilities: Flying version of Spinning Saw with more health/damage
Effective against heavy single-target clones
cards.description: An advanced saw that grows stronger against larger units.

cards.name: Bouncy Doom
abilities: High area/tower damage projectile
Harder to aim than Bouncy Bomb but hits much harder
cards.description: An unpredictable bouncing bomb solving difficult situations.

cards.name: Laser Bunnies
abilities: Fires a continuous wave of laser attacks
Good at clearing waves of small clones like Doggos
Strong vs flying (air) type clones
cards.description: Mechanical rabbits with laser attacks causing mass destruction.

cards.name: Blast Fish
abilities: Propels/blasts bombs forward toward the enemy tower
Requires practice to aim effectively
cards.description: A tagged unit that independently hunts remaining enemies.

cards.name: Bomb Drone
abilities: Self-guided flying unit that homes toward enemy structures
Pairs well with Flying Doggos for extra damage
cards.description: An aerial bomber delivering surprise attacks from above.

cards.name: Bomb Golem
abilities: Heavy tank unit with high stomp damage (823 at level 1)
On defeat, drops bombs that can be pushed/hammered/blasted into the tower
cards.description: A heavy walking bomb designed for explosive delivery.

cards.name: Bomb Spider
abilities: Walking unit that accelerates as it advances
On defeat, releases a Plain Bomb
cards.description: A mobile bomb that accelerates during its advance.

cards.name: Doggo Horde
abilities: Spawns 10 melee Doggo units per cast
High stomp damage (691 at level 1) when thrown onto incoming enemies
cards.description: Cannibalistic pack that consumes obstacles in their path.

cards.name: Flying Barrel
abilities: Self-guides across the bridge
Bursts to release multiple Bomb Birds (up to ~10 at higher levels)
cards.description: An airborne container with unexpected contents.

cards.name: Lumberjackie
abilities: Axe attack effective against clustered small clones (e.g. Doggo Horde, Bomb Birds)
Deals area damage (247 at level 1) around her strikes
cards.description: An axe-wielder capable of launching clones like projectiles.

cards.name: Puffer Bug
abilities: Expands and shoves nearby clones (friendly and enemy) with a large push force
Can help push friendly clones into the enemy tower or delay enemy advances
cards.description: An expanding unit that pushes all surrounding objects indiscriminately.

cards.name: Snatcher
abilities: Grabs an enemy bomb to protect the tower, or grabs a friendly bomb to charge it forward
Fast transporter for combos
cards.description: A precise transporter placing bombs at exact locations.

cards.name: Tornado
abilities: Pulls in all nearby clones, friendly and enemy, for 6 seconds
Can redirect friendly units toward the tower or group enemies for follow-up damage
cards.description: A wind vortex that lifts friendly units into the air.

cards.name: Big Bouncy Bomb
abilities: Larger, stronger version of Bouncy Bomb in every stat
Harder to control but deals significantly more damage on a direct hit
cards.description: A large bouncing explosive with reliable tower accuracy.

cards.name: Cluster Bomb
abilities: Splits into 3 Mini Bombs launched at a slight angle on explosion
cards.description: An advanced explosive that releases smaller bombs upon detonation.

cards.name: Core Bomber
abilities: Continuously drops mini bombs while alive
Drops 3 additional mini bombs when destroyed
cards.description: A floating device dropping bombs that multiply when destroyed.

cards.name: Bomb Frog
abilities: Hopping movement with great hitpoints and massive tower/stomp damage
On death, drops a Bouncy Bomb
cards.description: A springy bouncer crushing enemies with locked explosives.

cards.name: Anti Gravity
abilities: Holds all nearby enemy clones in place, making them unable to act, for 12 seconds
Deals stomp damage (170 at level 1) on cast
cards.description: A device creating temporary weightlessness affecting all opponents.

cards.name: Core Lightning
abilities: Chains lightning strikes across multiple nearby clones
Deals bonus/double damage to enemies affected by Icicle
cards.description: An observer generating lethal electrical discharges.

cards.name: Radioactive Bomb
abilities: Deals continuous small damage every frame over a 12-second lifetime (lowest per-hit damage, highest DPS in the game)
Damages all clones within its radius
cards.description: A decaying explosive harming everything nearby.

cards.name: Overseer
abilities: Picks up armed/fused bombs near her and continuously carries them to the tower with unlimited range
cards.description: A jetpack unit levitating bombs for rapid strikes.

cards.name: Mindtick
abilities: Takes control of an enemy clone, making it and anything it subsequently deploys fight for you
Effect lasts roughly 58 seconds
cards.description: A psychic parasite that controls affected enemy clones.

cards.name: Core Freezer
abilities: Follows and slows enemy clones until they become frozen
cards.description: A sky sentinel spreading ice that immobilizes enemies.

cards.name: Big Frost
abilities: Slow-moving unit with a freeze aura that slows nearby enemies until frozen
Releases a freezing nova on death
cards.description: A blizzard expert freezing opponents into art.

cards.name: Core Tri Bomb
abilities: Escalates through 3 stages that each get stronger
Best kept near your own tower until it reaches its 3rd stage for a powerful final attack
cards.description: A mysterious expanding device with undeniable destructive capability.
